text:
Jordan Park: OrbitAI pinged — they want orbit-20b-open listed in Marketplace + co-launch with Skyline Systems (edge appliance) and Helix Integrations (SI). Core asks: EU+US hosting zones, signed model bundles for on-prem installs, and explicit permission to redistribute quantized derivatives to SI partners. Target launch window: ~28 days.

Riley Adams: Marketplace needs SPDX license text, model-card, sha256 for weights, container manifest, and a 1-page perf summary. Also we should propose SKU breakdown: Hosted / Dedicated / Private (EU-only).

Samir Patel: Quick legal scan: license looks permissive but references third-party datasets. We should add a "Derivative Distribution Grant" clause and a short warranty carveout re: data provenance. Also run an export-controls check before we accept a launch date.

Priya Rao: Eng-ML note: we can produce q4_0 and q8_0 variants and small-int8 builds if OrbitAI allows it. We need explicit rights to ship those to SI and customers. Prefer partner-supplied quant artifacts but can convert if allowed. Minimal artifact checklist I need:
```
- model_id: orbit-20b-open
- weights: fp16 (sha256)
- tokenizer.json
- model-card.md
- optional: q4_0/q8_0 artifacts
- sample_input_set.tar.gz
- perf_report.csv
```
If OrbitAI can't grant redistribution, fallback is hosted-only + SI access via API.

Marco Velez: Ops: Skyline requires signed OCI images and FIPS 140-2 HSM support for customer key material on on-prem devices. Private/BYOK provisioning adds ~5 business days. Also add OCI signing and provenance.json to the ingest checklist.

helix-bot: SI integration checklist created: smoke tests, validation harness, and a reproducible perf script. Link: https://drive.re/orbit_si_harness (placeholder). Helix requests a 7-day validation window before embargo.

Jordan Park: Proposed responsibilities: Partnerships = partner comms & co-announcement; Marketplace/Riley = ingest & SKU pages; Eng-ML/Priya = quant + evals; Ops/Marco = OCI signing, KMS/HSM; Legal/Samir = license addendum + export review; SI/Helix = validation. Agree?

Riley Adams: Agree. I'll draft SKU mapping and a tentative pricing tier tonight.

Samir Patel: I'll draft a narrow addendum for "Derivative Distribution + Geofencing" and run export checks. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Priya Rao: I'll block Eng-ML time for conversion/eval; if OrbitAI supplies q artifacts we can shorten by 48 hours.

Marco Velez: I'll prepare OCI signing and BYOK runbook, and surface any infra blockers. ETA 48h.

Jordan Park: Action items recap: Riley -> SKU + ingest template. Samir -> addendum + export scan. Priya -> quant plan + perf harness. Marco -> ops/KMS + OCI signing instructions. Helix -> validation booking. Reconvene in 24h to confirm license and artifact availability. Flag blockers here. :calendar: :rocket:
